title: OpenAI Prompt Service State
description: Sends pipeline data to the OpenAI API and emits the model's response. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/openai-prompt)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

prompt.description: System / user prompt prepended to the pipeline value

responseIsJson.description: Parse the response as JSON before emitting

voice.description: TTS voice (for tts-1 model). One of alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer

injectPrompt.description: When true, appends the pipeline value to the configured prompt rather than replacing it
